name: Everyday Core

intent_defaults.description: A versatile everyday garment with restrained detailing and a silhouette that can be styled in several ways.

accessibility_defaults: Closures, openings and pocket placement remain user-editable.
circularity_defaults: Prefer replaceable fasteners and repairable seams where compatible with the design.
caveats: This preset does not guarantee a universal fit.
Material performance, durability, washability and environmental impact require material- and method-specific evidence.
